task.description: Review git diff origin/main -- scripts/test_parallel.sh (commit cca07118), Q-1037 / GH #2364. Read-only.

result.summary: REVIEWER PASS, no MAJOR. Watchdog/process-group/pids[] logic and exit-code contract untouched; only additive lines (epoch stamps via foreground date, runner line, phase elapsed, per-partition elapsed line after the unchanged 'partition N: ... exit' line, opt-in slowest awk). No set -e in script (only set -u, set -m); extra_args uses read -a (no glob) with the ${arr[@]+...} guard so empty is safe under set -u and bash 3/4; default-off command line is identical. No new background processes. awk traced against the real ExUnit format: header printed, first blank skipped, content printed, closing blank ends block; both tests and modules blocks handled; passed and failed partitions both reach it; nothing when unset. Runner line holds only nproc/cpu model/memtotal/loadavg, no secrets. date -u -d is GNU-only but falls back to 'unknown' (ubuntu-latest fine). Elapsed upper-bound caveat is documented in the header.

issues.description: awk edge: a 'Top N slowest' header with no content lines (empty block) would leave on=1 and print the next non-blank line (e.g. 'Finished in...'). ExUnit does not emit empty blocks, so cosmetic only.
Runner line is printed before the pre-compile step, after N derivation; fine, but 'once at start' is satisfied only after the N line. Per-partition end stamps are upper bounds (documented).
